answer.answer: The Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U) helps city households across officially defined lower and middle income bands obtain permanent homes [E02]. Launched on 25th June 2015 by the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs, it provides pucca houses to eligible urban households in the EWS (Economically Weaker Section), LIG (Low Income Group), and MIG (Middle Income Group) categories [E01][E02].
